summary: Iteration 132 - Claude Opus 4.6 Integration for Extension Capture Flow. Backend: 11/11 tests PASSED. All features verified working: (1) POST /api/extension/capture with raw_profile_text triggers Claude Opus 4.6 extraction via Emergent Universal Key, (2) Capture without raw_profile_text works (no AI enrichment), (3) Graceful fallback when Claude returns error, (4) POST /api/extension/ai-extract works (OpenAI primary, Claude fallback), (5) Recruiter phone/email filtering from AI results, (6) GET /api/extension/profile/{id} returns enriched data.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 132 tested Claude Opus 4.6 integration for extension capture flow. The integration uses Emergent Universal Key via emergentintegrations library (NOT AWS Bedrock). Key functions: extract_full_profile in /app/backend/services/bedrock_service.py, capture endpoint in /app/backend/routes/extension.py (lines 635-706). The capture endpoint requires 'scraped_at' field (ISO timestamp). Phone numbers may be blocked by stale phone protection if they already belong to another candidate. AI extraction is triggered when raw_profile_text > 100 chars.
